_metadata.description: Explicit reviewed exemptions for active pairwise interaction rules that must remain visible without a numeric high-dose threshold.
_metadata.purpose: Reviewed exemptions for active pairwise rules whose clinical copy mentions high-dose use but must not be suppressed by a numeric app gate.

pairwise_interaction_ids.DSI_LEVOTHYROXINE_SOY: The actionable issue is absorption timing for supplemental soy isoflavones; high-dose wording only adds follow-up monitoring and does not define a safe no-action floor.
pairwise_interaction_ids.DSI_ANTICONV_FOLATE: Folate management with anticonvulsants depends on seizure history, medication, and pregnancy context; a generic numeric floor cannot safely suppress clinician-review guidance.
pairwise_interaction_ids.DSI_WAR_OMEGA3: This source-reviewed interaction remains a prescriber/INR context warning without a numeric suppression cutoff. The mechanism and evidence belong to DSI_WAR_OMEGA3 in curated_interactions_v1.json, not this exemption map. Agent source review 2026-10-11; not a new clinician sign-off.
pairwise_interaction_ids.DSI_WAR_GINGER: The source-reviewed ginger/warfarin precaution has mixed human platelet evidence and no established 2g/day safe-below boundary. Retain prescriber/INR review without inventing a numeric suppression threshold.
pairwise_interaction_ids.DSI_FISHOIL_VITE: ODS describes vitamin E bleeding concerns and uncertain clinically significant amounts; neither the vitamin E upper limit nor fish-oil trial doses establish a combination safe-below boundary. Retain the qualified review without a numeric suppression floor.
